eve – build AI agents that you own
Get started with eve: durable AI agents in TypeScript

name: eve
summary: Vercel's filesystem-first framework for building AI agents from Markdown instructions and TypeScript tools, durable by default.
description: An agent is a directory: instructions.md defines its role, tools/ holds TypeScript functions, and skills/, channels/, connections/ and subagents/ extend it. eve compiles the directory, runs it on Vercel primitives (Workflows, Sandbox, AI Gateway) or self-hosted, and scaffolds projects with eve init. Open source under Apache-2.0.
